purpose: Teach: 敬愛/則っ/基い/準じ/使途/呼び掛け/打ち込み/ベルク

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 創業者を敬愛する記念式典を企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's plan a memorial ceremony to honor the founder.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful opening. Collaborative tone—proposing direction without commanding. Even pace, steady breath. A suggestion from someone genuinely invested in the idea.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内ルールに則って運営します
lines.en: Yes. We'll run it according to company policy.
lines.style: Affirming and grounded. Speaks with the comfort of someone who knows the procedures. Reliable, no hesitation. Slightly formal but not distant—showing respect for the framework.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 顧客調査に基いた商品設計を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's base our product design on customer research.
lines.style: Forward-thinking, confident proposal. Measured tempo. Direct eye contact level. The voice of someone who's thought this through and is guiding them toward the practical path.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。同業他社に準じて値段を決めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll set pricing in line with competitors.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Practical and matter-of-fact. No drama—just stating the logical approach. Slightly faster than previous line, showing momentum building.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 予算の使途を四半期ごとに公表しましょう
lines.en: Let's publish our budget allocations quarterly.
lines.style: Transparent and deliberate. Opens with gentle conviction. Moderate pace. The tone of someone who believes accountability matters and is stating it plainly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内呼び掛けの方法を改善します
lines.en: Yes. I'll work on improving how we communicate internally.
lines.style: Engaged and solution-focused. Light energy—not hesitant. Shows he's already thinking about the next step. Slightly warmer than the previous responses.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトに打ち込みつつ休息も取ろう
lines.en: Let's throw ourselves into this project but also take time to rest.
lines.style: Caring undertone beneath the direction. Slight warmth on 'rest'—she's thinking of them as people, not just workers. Earnest, genuine. Pacing allows each part its weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ベルク社との提携交渉を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move forward with the partnership negotiations with Belk.
lines.style: Closing statement with quiet determination. Solid, confident finish. Stands slightly firmer on 'move forward'—this is the actionable commitment. Warm but professional.
